verdict.rationale: SerpApi's API reference pages link to its own playground, described as a "live and interactive demo" for each engine. The GitHub client also mentions a first-party script builder, so runnable, interactive exploration exists alongside per-parameter reference docs. Evidence of depth is thin: the playground appears only as a one-line link, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at every candidate path. missing for 10: detail on what the playground supports (editable parameters, generated code samples), runnable examples embedded in the reference itself, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Head to the [playground](/playground?engine=google) for a live and interactive demo.
SerpApi provides a script builder to get you started quickly.
